summary: Backend + Frontend testing for profile customization (bio, social_links, photos, public /users/:id). Backend: 9/9 pytest tests passed. Frontend: profile screen, edit modal (photo grid + 0/7 counter + bio + 5 social inputs), bio+instagram persistence, comment-user navigation to /user/[id], public gallery with prev/next arrows and 'Nessuna foto' placeholder all working correctly.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 1400+ lines — consider splitting into modules (auth, feuds, comments, photos, admin, rss) for maintainability, but not blocking.
Photo base64 stored inline in MongoDB (up to ~2.5MB each) can bloat documents; consider GridFS or object storage in future iterations.

_sanitize_social_links prefixes '@handles' with nothing — the code path `if not starts with http and not starts with @` prepends https:// which means handles like 'tester.ig' get 'https://tester.ig' (a broken URL). This matches the test expectation (starts with https://) but the resulting link on the public profile will 404 in a browser. Consider platform-specific handle normalization (e.g. instagram -> https://instagram.com/<handle>).
seed_data_creation: Created fresh anonymous users per test run (nickname prefix 'pctest_' and 'uitest_'); no persistent seed data required.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Auth token is stored in AsyncStorage under key 'faide_token' (JSON-stringified on web localStorage). All new endpoints prefixed with /api. Public /users/{id} requires no auth.
